These bored members of the upper classes wage war from mobile fortresses and view the battlefield as their playground. Few in number, the Titan Lords usually offer their services as mercenaries, but on the rare occasions when they fight together, their armies of massive walkers are a spectacle to behold. With little fear of consequences for their actions, Titan Lords often wander from one battlefield to the next, seeking some sort of thrill or purpose that is lacking in their pampered lives. Within a relatively short time, humanity has managed to build up a large industrial base in their colonies throughout the Sirius Sector, and most of these are owned by a handful of powerful companies.... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/titan-lords) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Changebound: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls. ### Special Rules Delayed Action: Once per round, if your opponent has more units left to activate than you, then this model's unit may pass its turn instead of activating (may still be activated later). Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). ### Aura Special Rules Read more ### Spells Shifting Form (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which gets -3 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Sky Blaze (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. Breath of Change (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Bane when Shooting once (next time the effect would apply). Mutating Inferno (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each. Change Boon (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Changebound Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Power Bolt (3): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits with AP(2). ### Units ### Vehicles / Monsters Change Vassal Micro-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 215pts Heavy Hammer(A1, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A3, AP(1)) Changebound, Fear(1), Fortified, Tough(9) Change Errant Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 315pts Heavy Hammer(A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Changebound, Fear(2), Fortified, Furious, Tough(12) Change Pilgrim Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 380pts Fusion Blaster(24", A1, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Changebound, Fear(2), Fortified, Tough(12) Change Yeoman Mini-Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 475pts 2x Fusion Blaster(24", A1, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Stomp(A4, AP(1)) Changebound, Fear(2), Relentless, Tough(12) ### Titans Change Paladin Light Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 520pts Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Heavy Hammer(A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), Stomp(A6, AP(2)) Changebound, Fear(3), Fortified, Tough(18) Change Questor Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 745pts Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)), Titan Hammer(A4, AP(1), Blast(3)) Changebound, Fear(4), Fortified, Furious, Tough(24) Change Knight Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 870pts Titan Fusion Cannon(24", A2, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)) Changebound, Fear(4), Fortified, Tough(24) Change Duke Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 1060pts 2x Titan Fusion Cannon(24", A2, AP(4), Deadly(6)), Hull-Fuser(12", A1, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A8, AP(2)) Changebound, Fear(4), Relentless, Tough(24) Change King Heavy Titan [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 1155pts Twin Shoulder-Cannon(24", A2, AP(1), Blast(3)), 2x Titan Harpoon Cannon(18", A1, AP(4), Deadly(9)), Twin Hull-Fuser(12", A2, AP(4), Deadly(3)), Stomp(A10, AP(3)) Changebound, Fear(4), Tough(30) Images: -
